SELECT * FROM (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_quarter DESC) AS _rn, *
FROM (SELECT t.company, t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_quarter, t.calendar_quarter, t.days,
       t.inventory AS inventory,
       t.revenue AS revenue,
       t.cogs AS cogs,
       t.accounts_receivable AS accounts_receivable,
       t.accounts_payable AS accounts_payable
FROM (SELECT p.company_id AS company, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_quarter, p.calendar_quarter, p.days,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'accounts_payable' THEN f.value END) AS accounts_payable,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'accounts_receivable' THEN f.value END) AS accounts_receivable,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'cogs' THEN f.value END) AS cogs,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'inventory' THEN f.value END) AS inventory,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'revenue' THEN f.value END) AS revenue
FROM facts f
JOIN periods p USING (company_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter)
WHERE f.version = 'original' AND p.company_id IN ('Lenovo')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) t
ORDER BY t.company, t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_quarter)
) WHERE _rn <= 8 ORDER BY company, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter

SELECT t.company, t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_quarter, t.calendar_quarter, t.days,
       (t.gross_profit / NULLIF(t.revenue, 0)) AS gross_margin,
       t.revenue AS revenue,
       t.gross_profit AS gross_profit,
       t.cogs AS cogs
FROM (SELECT p.company_id AS company, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_quarter, p.calendar_quarter, p.days,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'cogs' THEN f.value END) AS cogs,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'gross_profit' THEN f.value END) AS gross_profit,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'revenue' THEN f.value END) AS revenue
FROM facts f
JOIN periods p USING (company_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter)
WHERE f.version = 'original' AND p.company_id IN ('Lenovo') AND (p.fiscal_year > 2024 OR (p.fiscal_year = 2024 AND p.fiscal_quarter >= 1)) AND (p.fiscal_year < 2026 OR (p.fiscal_year = 2026 AND p.fiscal_quarter <= 3))
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) t
ORDER BY t.company, t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_quarter

SELECT p.company_id AS company, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_quarter, p.calendar_quarter, p.days,
       d.region, d.product_line, d.account_code AS metric, d.value
FROM facts_detail d
JOIN periods p USING (company_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter)
JOIN facts f ON f.company_id = p.company_id AND f.fiscal_year = p.fiscal_year
            AND f.fiscal_quarter = p.fiscal_quarter AND f.account_code = d.account_code
WHERE f.version = 'original' AND p.company_id IN ('Lenovo') AND (p.fiscal_year > 2025 OR (p.fiscal_year = 2025 AND p.fiscal_quarter >= 1)) AND (p.fiscal_year < 2026 OR (p.fiscal_year = 2026 AND p.fiscal_quarter <= 3))
ORDER BY p.company_id, p.period_end, d.region, d.product_line, d.account_code

args.sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, SUM(value) AS rev
  FROM facts_detail
  WHERE company_id='Lenovo' AND fiscal_year IN (2025,2026) AND fiscal_quarter IN (1,2,3)
    AND account_code='revenue'
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
pl AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, product_line, SUM(value) AS revenue
  FROM facts_detail
  WHERE company_id='Lenovo' AND fiscal_year IN (2025,2026) AND fiscal_quarter IN (1,2,3)
    AND account_code='revenue'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT pl.fiscal_year, pl.fiscal_quarter, pl.product_line, pl.revenue,
       ROUND(pl.revenue / q.rev * 100, 2) AS pct
FROM pl JOIN q ON q.fiscal_year=pl.fiscal_year AND q.fiscal_quarter=pl.fiscal_quarter
WHERE pl.product_line IN ('PC','Other')
ORDER BY 1,2,3
